grammar.pattern: 主语 + 被 + 施事 + 动作；省略施事
grammar.purpose: Follow the affected item in a passive
grammar.explanation: 行李被同学移到门后了 names the agent. 行李被移到门后了 does not. Passive wording alone does not justify inventing an agent or intention. This expands the earlier 在雨中被弄湿 event with an explicit agent and result location.

examples.zh: 行李被同学移到门后了。
examples.py: xíng lǐ bèi tóng xué yí dào mén hòu le .
examples.en: A classmate moved the luggage behind the door.

examples.py: dài zi bèi huà pò le .
examples.en: The bag was cut or scratched open.

examples.py: bāo bèi fàng zài yī jià páng biān .
examples.en: The bag was put beside the clothes rack.

commonMistakes.wrong: 行李被移走了，所以一定是她。
commonMistakes.right: 行李被移走了，还不知道是谁。
commonMistakes.why: An omitted agent cannot be inferred with certainty.

grammar.explanation: 我是来领行李的 emphasizes the stated purpose. 是这个包被移走了 corrects which bag was moved. Emphasis is a speaker’s assertion, not independent evidence; distinguish this from the previously taught identification 是.

examples.py: wǒ shì lái lǐng xíng lǐ de .
examples.en: I came to collect the luggage.

examples.py: shì zhè gè bāo bèi yí zǒu le .
examples.en: It is this bag that was moved.

examples.py: wǒ shì zhēn de méi kàn jiàn .
examples.en: I really did not see it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她说是真的，所以不需要核对。
commonMistakes.right: 她强调是真的，仍要核对具体事实。
commonMistakes.why: Emphasis does not replace checking facts.

dialogue.title: The missing bag
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the bag without assigning blame.

lines.zh: 我的行李不在这里，是谁移走了？
lines.py: wǒ de xíng lǐ bù zài zhè lǐ , shì shéi yí zǒu le ?
lines.en: My luggage is not here. Who moved it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 板上写行李被移到门后了，没有写是谁。
lines.py: bǎn shàng xiě xíng lǐ bèi yí dào mén hòu le , méi yǒu xiě shì shéi .
lines.en: The board says it was moved behind the door; it does not say by whom.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是这个包吗？周围没有姓名。
lines.py: shì zhè gè bāo ma ? zhōu wéi méi yǒu xìng míng .
lines.en: Is it this bag? There is no name around it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先问本人。衣架旁边的皮裙、衬衫和短裤放在一起。
lines.py: xiān wèn běn rén . yī jià páng biān de pí qún , chèn shān hé duǎn kù fàng zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: Ask the person first. The leather skirt, shirt and shorts are together beside the rack.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我是来领行李的，不是来找别人吵架的。
lines.py: wǒ shì lái lǐng xíng lǐ de , bù shì lái zhǎo bié ren chǎo jià de .
lines.en: I came to collect luggage, not quarrel with anyone.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，先保护原来的记录。门自动关了，别围着门。
lines.py: hǎo , xiān bǎo hù yuán lái de jì lù . mén zì dòng guān le , bié wéi zhe mén .
lines.en: Good; preserve the original record first. The door closed automatically; do not crowd it.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Where does the board place the luggage?
Does the board identify who moved it?

reading.title: Record, then confirm
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 屋子里有木板和衣架，服装放在一个箱子里。
lines.py: wū zi lǐ yǒu mù bǎn hé yī jià , fú zhuāng fàng zài yī gè xiāng zi lǐ .
lines.en: The room has a wooden board and a rack; clothing is in one box.

lines.zh: 一部手机在自己的包里，部不表示主人有几个人。
lines.py: yī bù shǒu jī zài zì jǐ de bāo lǐ , bù bù biǎo shì zhǔ rén yǒu jǐ gè rén .
lines.en: One phone is in the owner’s bag; 部 does not count owners.

lines.zh: 包带原来抓在手里，绳子断了，她退了一步，背上没有受伤。
lines.py: bāo dài yuán lái zhuā zài shǒu lǐ , shéng zi duàn le , tā tuì le yī bù , bèi shàng méi yǒu shòu shāng .
lines.en: She had held the strap; the cord broke; she stepped back and her back was uninjured.

lines.zh: 袋子被划破，不代表里面全部破坏；刀仍在盒子里。
lines.py: dài zi bèi huà pò , bù dài biǎo lǐ miàn quán bù pò huài ; dāo réng zài hé zi lǐ .
lines.en: A torn bag does not imply all its contents are damaged; the knife remains in its box.

lines.zh: 防灰尘的罩子保护物品；先保住记录，再领自己的包。
lines.py: fáng huī chén de zhào zi bǎo hù wù pǐn ; xiān bǎo zhù jì lù , zài lǐng zì jǐ de bāo .
lines.en: The dust cover protects the items; preserve the record before collecting one’s bag.

lines.zh: 抓住线索也要核对，别围着门挡路。是来取包，不是替人判断责任。
lines.py: zhuā zhù xiàn suǒ yě yào hé duì , bié wéi zhe mén dǎng lù . shì lái qǔ bāo , bù shì tì rén pàn duàn zé rèn .
lines.en: Verify clues and do not block the doorway; the purpose is collecting a bag, not assigning blame.
